'''2002 Bespin Regionals Sealed Deck''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck in June 2002. [[Jim Li]] won it. It is known from Josh Kohman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3755">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-17-bespin-regionals-kohman-brings-a-broomd3755/ bespin-regionals-kohman-brings-a-broom], DeckTech (Josh-e-poo "supaposhjosh" Kohman, 17 June 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-06-17-bespin-regionals-kohman-brings-a-broomd3755/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2002 Bespin Regionals]].

* '''Date:''' June 2002
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]
